parsed.post: Discarding my last run (1.111). The combination of DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.1 is hitting stability limits. Reverting to 1.059. Next: I'll try a higher MATRIX_LR of 0.15 with a WARMUP_RATIO of 0.1 to see if extra warmup allows for more aggressive learning.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.15 and WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to find if more aggressive learning can be stabilized by longer warmup.
